label: Exploratory V5 F4 with entry Seam-Pin exclusion candidate I2
assumptions: This is not nimble-knots-artillery-v5 and has no runtime, replay, protocol, reward, UI, asset, or product authority.

It keeps Candidate F4's complete ideal-direct-hit values and tactical core: 30/45/80 damage, 640/576/512 ranges, forward Seam Pin, equal 128 Escape Slack, prepared Spoolburst, Spun Cocoon, and compulsory 64-unit Threadback Unweave.

A Needlepoint cast that is outside maximum range before its own movement and inside range after that movement remains a legal combined move-and-cast for 30 damage, but it applies no Seam Pin and starts no Seam-Pin cooldown.
The suppression is an edge-scoped cast interpretation, not a status, resource, special response, reaction action, delayed cast, or persistent tactical-state field.

Stationary and already-in-band Needlepoint behavior, Threadball, Spoolburst preparation and stationary release, Unweave, Threadback, Escape Slack, movement, values, policies, and search depth are unchanged.
Terrain, aim, trajectory, splash, player skill, live Loomkeeper behavior, animation, UI, replay, reward, and production counter-effects remain excluded.
